PROP-attendanceze-asm-001.text: Supabase RLS policies must enforce row-level isolation for attendance and member tables.
PROP-attendanceze-asm-001.assertion: forall table in [attendance, members]: rls_enabled(table) && rls_policies_enforce_user_scope(table)

locations.note: RLS-respecting client: uses ANON_KEY with cookie-based auth so RLS policies are evaluated for authenticated user scope.
Admin client bypasses RLS entirely (service_role). RLS policy definitions are in Supabase SQL migrations, not in application code.
